source.quote: _Medium Swarm of Tiny Undead, Neutral Evil_
_Large Celestial, Fey, or Fiend (Your Choice), Neutral_

held.case: Ghoul Claw against a creature that is not Undead
held.why: the rider save excludes Elves; a creature template's header lists its type and descriptive tags (monsters.md:7, :65-67), but no source statement makes those tags a statement of species, and a creature instance records no species. Absence of an Elf tag is not evidence of not being an Elf (governing instruction). Refuses before any die; open policy point surfaced with this evidence.
its bat or mist form's type is not stated (monsters-A-Z.md:17724) and the form is not represented; refuses until it is

held.case: a creature whose stored creature_type departs from its template's fixed type (a familiar's chosen type)
held.why: the departure's source (a spell or feature) is not represented; an unvalidated stored type is not trusted: refuses

held.case: a creature under Shapechange, Polymorph or another form-changing spell; a character in Wild Shape
held.why: general spell execution is excluded; such effects refuse as unexecuted active effects. Wild Shape keeps the character's type (classes.md:3505), so a character's type stays its species type

I1.basis: the header line is the creature-type entry (monsters.md:7); no glossary rule names a swarm type, so the plural noun is read as the type
I1.claim: A swarm's creature type is the type of the creatures it is a swarm of (Swarm of Tiny Beasts: Beast; of Tiny Undead: Undead).

I2.basis: the stat block states the type with the other game statistics; Wild Shape, which replaces game statistics, says so explicitly
I2.claim: A creature type is among the game statistics a Shape-Shift keeps 'the same in each form'.

schema.invariant: exactly one of type / a non-empty sorted, distinct type_choice
